48068-cursed.title: Cursed
48068-cursed.creator: George Allan England
48068-cursed.description: A book by George Allan England. Slashed across the copper bowl of sunset, the jagged silhouette of tawny-shouldered mountains, fringed with areca-palms in black fretwork against the swift-fading glow, divided the tropic sky. Below, night’s dim shroud, here and there spangled with glow-lights still or moving, had already folded earth in its obscurity.

52778-the-gases-of-the-atmosphere-the-hi.title: History Of Their Discovery
52778-the-gases-of-the-atmosphere-the-hi.creator: William Ramsay, F.R.S.
52778-the-gases-of-the-atmosphere-the-hi.description: A book by William Ramsay, F.R.S.. To tell the story of the development of men’s ideas regarding the nature of atmospheric air is in great part to write a history of chemistry and physics. This history is an attractive and varied one: in its early stages it was expressed in the quaint terms of ancient mythology, while in its later developments it illustrates the advantage of careful experimental inquiry.

60167-three-plays.creator: Unknown
60167-three-plays.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. He has a certain   pleasing gift of words. Every now and then a neat line catches the   ear, as when Polonius (well played by Mr. Macready Jones) warns   his son that “borrowing often loses a man his friends,” or when   Hamlet himself refers to death as “a shuffling off of this mortal   toil.” But a succession of neat lines does not make a play.

arxiv-2109-01017.title: Coherent cochain complexes and Beilinson t-structures, with an appendix by Achim Krause
arxiv-2109-01017.creator: Stefano Ariotta
arxiv-2109-01017.description: Abstract . We define and study coherent cochain complexes in arbitrary stable ∞ \infty -categories, following Joyal. Our main result is that the ∞ \infty -category of coherent cochain complexes in a stable ∞ \infty -category C {C} is equivalent to the ∞ \infty -category of complete filtered objects in C {C} .

arxiv-2111-08570.title: Tracking Blobs in the Turbulent Edge Plasma of a Tokamak Fusion Device
arxiv-2111-08570.creator: Woonghee Han, Randall A. Pietersen, Rafael Villamor-Lora, Matthew Beveridge, Nicola Offeddu, Theodore Golfinopoulos, Christian Theiler, James L. Terry, Earl S. Marmar, Iddo Drori
arxiv-2111-08570.description: Abstract The analysis of turbulence in plasmas is fundamental in fusion research. Despite extensive progress in theoretical modeling in the past 15 years, we still lack a complete and consistent understanding of turbulence in magnetic confinement devices, such as tokamaks. Experimental studies are challenging due to the diverse processes that drive the high-speed dynamics of turbulent phenomena.

arxiv-2303-00582.title: Dishing out DoS: How to Disable and Secure the Starlink User Terminal
arxiv-2303-00582.creator: Joshua Smailes †, Edd Salkield †, Sebastian Köhler, Simon Birnbach, Ivan Martinovic
arxiv-2303-00582.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Joshua Smailes †, Edd Salkield †, Sebastian Köhler, Simon Birnbach, Ivan Martinovic. Satellite user terminals are a promising target for adversaries seeking to target satellite communication networks. Despite this, many protections commonly found in terrestrial routers are not present in some user terminals. As a case study we audit the attack surface presented by the Starlink router’s admin interface, using fuzzing to uncover a denial of service attack on the Starlink user terminal.

arxiv-2303-08681.title: Ab initio spectroscopic studies of AlF and AlCl molecules
arxiv-2303-08681.creator: R. Bala, V. S. Prasannaa, D. Chakravarti, D. Mukherjee, B. P. Das
arxiv-2303-08681.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by R. Bala, V. S. Prasannaa, D. Chakravarti, D. Mukherjee, B. P. Das. In this work, we report results from our extensive spectroscopic study on AlF and AlCl molecules, keeping in mind potential laboratory as well as astrophysical applications. We carry out detailed electronic structure calculations in both the molecules, including obtaining the potential energy surfaces of the X 1 ​ Σ X^{1}\Sigma ground electronic state and some of the relevant low-lying excited electronic states belonging to Σ \Sigma and Π \Pi symmetries.

arxiv-2309-05820.title: On the large scale geometry of big mapping class groups of surfaces with a unique maximal end
arxiv-2309-05820.creator: Rita Jiménez Rolland and Israel Morales
arxiv-2309-05820.description: Abstract . Building on the work of K. Mann and K. Rafi [ 11 ] , we analyze the large scale geometry of big mapping class groups of surfaces with a unique maximal end. We obtain a complete characterization of those that are globally CB, which does not require the tameness condition.

arxiv-2309-13342.title: Evolve the Model Universe of a System Universe Thanks: This work is supported by the Co-tester project (No. 314544) funded by the Research Council of Norway.
arxiv-2309-13342.creator: 1 st Tao Yue, 2 nd Shaukat Ali
arxiv-2309-13342.description: Abstract Uncertain, unpredictable, real-time, and lifelong evolution causes operational failures in intelligent software systems, leading to significant damages, safety and security hazards, and tragedies. To fully unleash such systems’ potential and facilitate their wider adoption, ensuring the trustworthiness of their decision-making under uncertainty is the prime challenge.

arxiv-2412-17547.title: Probability-Density-Aware Semi-supervised Learning
arxiv-2412-17547.creator: Shuyang Liu, Ruiqiu Zheng, Zhou Yu, Yunhang Shen, Zhou Yu, Ke Li, Xing Sun, Shaohui Lin
arxiv-2412-17547.description: Abstract Semi-supervised learning (SSL) assumes that neighbor points lie in the same category ( neighbor assumption ), and points in different clusters belong to various categories ( cluster assumption ). Existing methods usually rely on similarity measures to retrieve the similar neighbor points, ignoring cluster assumption , which may not utilize unlabeled information sufficiently and effectively.

arxiv-2501-14143.title: An Extensive and Methodical Review of Smart Grids for Sustainable Energy Management-Addressing Challenges with AI, Renewable Energy Integration and Leading-edge Technologies
arxiv-2501-14143.creator: PARAG BISWAS 1, ABDUR RASHID 1, ABDULLAH AL MASUM 1, MD ABDULLAH AL NASIM 2, A.S.M ANAS FERDOUS 4, KISHOR DATTA GUPTA 3, ANGONA BISWAS 2
arxiv-2501-14143.description: Abstract Energy management decreases energy expenditures and consumption while simultaneously increasing energy efficiency, reducing carbon emissions, and enhancing operational performance. Smart grids are a type of sophisticated energy infrastructure that increase the generation and distribution of electricity’s sustainability, dependability, and efficiency by utilizing digital communication technologies. They combine a number of cutting-edge techniques and technology to improve energy resource management.

arxiv-2505-02683.title: Partons from stabilizer codes
arxiv-2505-02683.creator: Rafael A. Macêdo, Carlo C. Bellinati, Weslei B. Fontana, Eric C. Andrade, Rodrigo G. Pereira
arxiv-2505-02683.description: Abstract The Gutzwiller projection of fermionic wave functions is a well-established method for generating variational wave functions describing exotic states of matter, such as quantum spin liquids. We investigate the conditions under which a projected wave function constructed from fermionic partons can be rigorously shown to possess topological order.

arxiv-2508-16988.title: Probing Dynamical Electrical Conductivity via Dilepton Emission: A Kinetic theory approach
arxiv-2508-16988.creator: Ashutosh Dwibedi 1 , Ankit Kumar Panda 1 , Sabyasachi Ghosh 1 , and Victor Roy 2
arxiv-2508-16988.description: Abstract Dileptons serve as a clean and penetrating probe of the Quark–Gluon Plasma created in high-energy heavy-ion collisions. In this work, we investigate thermal dilepton spectra and their elliptic flow through the dynamical conductivity that governs the production rate. The conductivity is obtained from the trace of the spectral function within relativistic kinetic theory using the Relaxation Time Approximation.

arxiv-2602-10158.title: NMRTrans: Structure Elucidation from Experimental NMR Spectra via Set Transformers Conference: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 2026; Jeju, Korea CCS: Applied computing Molecular structural biology
arxiv-2602-10158.creator: Liujia Yang ∗ Zhuo Yang ∗, Jiaqing Xie ∗ Yubin Wang ∗, Ben Gao Xingjian Wei Jiaxing Sun, Tianfan Fu, Jiang Wu † Conghui He †, Yuqiang Li † Qinying Gu †
arxiv-2602-10158.description: Abstract . Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy is fundamental for molecular structure elucidation, yet interpreting spectra at scale remains time-consuming and highly expertise-dependent. While recent spectrum-as-language modeling and retrieval-based methods have shown promise, they rely heavily on large corpora of computed spectra and exhibit notable performance drops when applied to experimental measurements.

Our aim was to compare hypertension awareness, treatment, and control, and how they have changed over time, in high-income countries. Methods We used data from people aged 40-79 years

pmc-10525913.title: Processing Ultrasound Scans of the Inferior Vena Cava: Techniques and Applications
pmc-10525913.creator: Piero Policastro, Luca Mesin, Giuseppe Baselli
pmc-10525913.description: The inferior vena cava (IVC) is the largest vein in the body. It returns deoxygenated blood to the heart from the tissues placed under the diaphragm. The size and dynamics of the IVC depend on the blood volume and right atrial pressure, which are important indicators of a patient’s hydration and reflect possible pathological conditions.

pmc-11480873.title: Prognostic prediction of breast cancer patients using machine learning models: a retrospective analysis
pmc-11480873.creator: Xuchun Song, Jiebin Chu, Zijie Guo, Qun Wei, Qingchuan Wang, Wenxian Hu, Linbo Wang, Wenhe Zhao, Heming Zheng, Xudong Lu, Jichun Zhou
pmc-11480873.description: BackgroundBreast cancer is a common and complex disease, with various clinical features affecting prognosis. Accurate prediction of prognosis is essential for guiding personalized treatment strategies. This study aimed to develop machine learning models for predicting prognosis in breast cancer patients using retrospective data.

pmc-11521620.title: Interactions between soil and other environmental variables modulate forest expansion and ecotone dynamics in humid savannas of Central Africa
pmc-11521620.creator: Le Bienfaiteur Takougoum Sagang, Imma Tcheferi, Pierre Ploton, Moses Libalah, Murielle Simo-Droissart, Nelly Sirri, Gilles Dauby, Eric Ngansop, Jean Pierre Bissek, Narcisse Kamdem, Gislain I I Mofack, Donatien Zebaze, Hugo Leblanc, Fabrice Djonko, Bonaventure Sonké, Nicolas Barbier, Pierre Couteron
pmc-11521620.description: Forest expansion into savanna is a pervasive phenomenon in West and Central Africa, warranting comparative studies under diverse environmental conditions. We collected vegetation data from the woody and grassy components within 73 plots of 0.16 ha distributed along a successional gradient from humid savanna to forest in Central Africa.

pmc-11626071.title: Effect of calcium ions on the aggregation of highly phosphorylated tau
pmc-11626071.creator: Toru Tanaka, Sachiyo Ohashi, Akihiko Takashima, Shunsuke Kobayashi
pmc-11626071.description: Tau is typically an axonal protein, but in neurons of brains affected by Alzheimer's disease (AD), aggregation of hyperphosphorylated tau in the somatodendritic compartment causes neuronal death. We have previously demonstrated that tau mRNA is transported within dendrites and undergoes immediate translation and hyperphosphorylation of AD epitopes in response to NMDA receptor stimulation.

pmc-12731398.title: Association of Vitamin D Deficiency with Diabetic Nephropathy in Type 2 Diabetes: A Hospital-Based Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12731398.creator: Shafia Bashir, Geer Mohammad Ishaq, Insha Mushtaq, Mohammad Ashraf Ganie, Imtiyaz Wani, Muteb Alanazi, Ibrahim Asiri, Arshad Hussain, Kashif Ullah Khan, Sirajudheen Anwar, Ilse Daehn, Lucas Fornari Laurindo, Sandra Barbalho
pmc-12731398.description: Background/Objective: Diabetic nephropathy (DN), a key microvascular complication of type 2 diabetes (T2DM), drives significant morbidity, mortality, and healthcare costs. Vitamin D deficiency has been linked to renal dysfunction, but its role in DN remains unclear. This study assessed the association between vitamin D status and DN versus T2DM without nephropathy.

pmc-13118042.title: Relationship Between Sperm DNA Fragmentation and Composite Morphological Indices: A Multivariable Analysis
pmc-13118042.creator: Veliscu Andreea Carp, Liana Ștefan, Petronela Naghi, Diana Mocuța, Cristina Aur, Liliana Sachelarie, Mircea Sandor
pmc-13118042.description: Background and Objectives: Although conventional semen analysis remains central in male infertility evaluation, the biological relationship between sperm morphology and genomic integrity remains incompletely defined. Sperm DNA fragmentation (SDF) has emerged as a clinically relevant marker of genomic instability; however, its relationship with composite morphological indices of spermatogenic dysfunction remains debated.
